Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a streamlined financial aid process for community and technical colleges.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to centralizing financial aid administration forcommunity and technical colleges; and adding a new section to chapter28B.50 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.50 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The college board shall create an efficient, streamlined, andsimple financial aid process for colleges and students. The newprocess must include, but not be limited to, standardized applicationforms, eligibility criteria, deadlines, award verification, andpublished informational materials. (2) A detailed implementation plan of the new process shall beapproved by the college board by September 2011 with fullimplementation of the process no later than January 2012. (3) The college board shall disclose all information necessary forcompliance with RCW 28B.15.0681 and 28B.76.300(4) to each collegedistrict.
